content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was the presence of a variable `shost` in the function `lpfc_dev_loss_tmo_handler()` that was set but never used. This indicates that the variable was likely intended for some purpose related to the SCSI host but was either not implemented correctly or was left over from previous code that was modified or removed. The unused variable could lead to confusion for developers maintaining the code, as it suggests that there may have been an intended functionality that was not realized. The patch effectively removes this unnecessary variable to clean up the code.

Root cause:
The root cause of the bug was the presence of a variable `shost` in the function `lpfc_dev_loss_tmo_handler()` that was set but never used. This indicates that the variable was likely intended for some purpose related to the SCSI host but was either not implemented correctly or was left over from previous code that was modified or removed. The unused variable could lead to confusion for developers maintaining the code, as it suggests that there may have been an intended functionality that was not realized. The patch effectively removes this unnecessary variable to clean up the code.
Patch:
From 09b15e35071d35947b6e6da5b1a1d0cab73c12a6 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: James Smart <james.smart@broadcom.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2020 12:33:53 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] scsi: lpfc: Fix set but unused variables in
 lpfc_dev_loss_tmo_handler()

Remove set but not used variable shost in lpfc_dev_loss_tmo_handler().

Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20201119203353.121866-1-james.smart@broadcom.com
Fixes: 52edb2caf675 ("scsi: lpfc: Remove ndlp when a PLOGI/ADISC/PRLI/REG_RPI ultimately fails")
Reported-by: kernel test robot <lkp@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: James Smart <james.smart@broadcom.com>
Signed-off-by: Martin K. Petersen <martin.petersen@oracle.com>
---
 drivers/scsi/lpfc/lpfc_hbadisc.c | 2 --
 1 file changed, 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/drivers/scsi/lpfc/lpfc_hbadisc.c b/drivers/scsi/lpfc/lpfc_hbadisc.c
index 44eddddff0dc..2b6b5fc671fe 100644
--- a/drivers/scsi/lpfc/lpfc_hbadisc.c
+++ b/drivers/scsi/lpfc/lpfc_hbadisc.c
@@ -244,14 +244,12 @@ lpfc_dev_loss_tmo_handler(struct lpfc_nodelist *ndlp)
 {
 	struct lpfc_vport *vport;
 	struct lpfc_hba   *phba;
-	struct Scsi_Host  *shost;
 	uint8_t *name;
 	int warn_on = 0;
 	int fcf_inuse = 0;
 	unsigned long iflags;
 
 	vport = ndlp->vport;
-	shost = lpfc_shost_from_vport(vport);
 	name = (uint8_t *)&ndlp->nlp_portname;
 	phba = vport->phba;
 
--
